Natalie: Happy holidays, team! Quick fun thread — we should do a little "shelfie" contest this month (show off your cozy corner/shelf/decor). Who's in? :tada:
Aj: I'm in. Will probably enter my ridiculous reindeer mug pic :joy:
Chris: Count me in, my balcony lights are already out and looking extra chaotic this year :sparkles:
Maria: Love it. Also — quick hot-drink poll while we're at it: mulled wine, spiced cider, or peppermint hot chocolate? Vote with emoji or reply.
Samir: Mulled wine for sure :wine_glass:
Leo: Peppermint hot chocolate all the way :chocolate_bar:
Aj: Spiced cider here :apple:
Maria: Sweet. I'll drop a Google Photos album link later and a short form to collect entries (simple: name + pic + 1-liner).
Natalie: Prizes? Maybe a $25 gift card for 1st, sticker pack for 2nd, and company swag for 3rd? Tiny but festive.
Chris: Yes to prizes. Also can we have a People's Choice and an Ops Favorite? :thinking_face:
Maria: Love two categories — I'll be organizer. Tagging judges: @Natalie @Chris @Leo
Natalie: Happy to judge. :thumbsup:
holiday-bot: Reminder: upload deadline Dec 22 23:59 UTC. Use the album link Maria posts.
Aj: Will post mug photo tonight. Also can we do a secret ingredient thread for hot drinks? (mine is a pinch of cayenne in cocoa) :smirk:
Samir: Nice. I'll take a stab at a warmed apple-cinnamon riff.
Maria: Album link (placeholder): https://photos.app.goo.gl/example — drop photos there or reply here with attachments.

Natalie: OK team, holiday cheer officially started. Thanks for the energy! :tada:
